_comment: Reference measurements taken from govox-py BEFORE the Rust port changed anything.
Moving CTranslate2 -> GGUF changes the model files, so these numbers are not
reproducible after the fact. The gate is 'no worse', not 'identical':
WER_rs <= WER_py + 1.0 absolute, and p95_latency_rs <= p95_latency_py.
Chasing exact equality across a model-format change would burn weeks for nothing.

latency.method: 1 warmup run then 20 timed runs; nearest-rank p95; transcribe+correct only, injection excluded

machine.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU (8188 MiB)

caveat: hello.wav is a 1.5s single-word utterance, so this is a floor measurement
dominated by fixed overhead rather than a representative dictation latency.
Before M5 claims parity, re-run over a corpus of realistic utterances
(5-15s of connected speech) on BOTH implementations.

blocker: Needs a speech corpus with reference transcripts, which this repo does not have.
Plan: ~150 utterances of Rocky's own speech in the real usage domain, plus a
LibriSpeech test-clean slice. Measure on govox-py/CT2 first and record here,
then on govox-rs/GGUF over the identical audio.
